3329974.name: Chabad of the University of Rhode Island
3329974.note: Chabad.org News, Oct 31 2017 ('Doubling Presence in a Decade, 14 New Chabad Campus Centers Opened This Year'): 'Rabbi Avraham Adam ("Avi") and Tzippy Goldstein arrived at the University of Rhode Island in Kingston, R.I., last year before Sukkot', i.e. before Sukkot 2016 (the listing number also points to 2016).

3548886.name: Middlebury Chabad
3548886.note: Chabad.org News, Oct 31 2017 ('14 New Chabad Campus Centers Opened This Year'): 'Rabbi Binyamin (aka "Rabbi B") and Davida Murray, co-directors of Middlebury Chabad in Middlebury, Vt., arrived this August'. (therebbesimpact.com: 2017.)

3479615.name: Chabad at Chapman University
3479615.note: Chabad.org News, Oct 31 2017 ('14 New Chabad Campus Centers Opened This Year'): 'Rabbi Eliezer and Mushky Gurary co-direct Chabad of Chapman University in Orange, Calif. The Gurarys moved out in February to serve four universities, including Chapman; California State University, Fullerton; Fullerton College and Rancho Santiago Community College District.' (therebbesimpact.com: 2016; the chabad.org listing, 3479615, was made about Sept 2016, before they moved.)

5644326.name: Chabad of Northwest Vermont
5644326.note: JNS, Nov 21 2022 ('A new Chabad every three days', on the 120 new Chabad centers of the past year): 'two new Chabad centers have opened in Vermont: Chabad of Northwest Vermont in South Burlington, led by Rabbi Shmuel and Gittel Grossman, and Chabad of Stowe'. (therebbesimpact.com and the listing number also point to 2022.)

3401602.name: Chabad of Downtown San Jose
3401602.note: Rabbi Shaya Bernstein's LinkedIn: rabbi of Chabad at SJSU (Downtown San Jose) since Aug 2016; therebbesimpact.com also has 2016. Self-reported; to check. Checked (Nov 6): Chabad.org News, Oct 31 2017 ('14 New Chabad Campus Centers Opened This Year', https://www.chabad.org/news/article_cdo/aid/3831481/jewish/Doubling-Presence-in-a-Decade-14-New-Chabad-Campus-Centers-Opened-This-Year.htm): 'Rabbi Shaya and Brochy Bernstein headed to San Jose, Calif., last August to serve the nearly 800 Jewish students at San Jose State University', i.e. Aug 2016, so high.

2698131.name: Chabad of Bennington County
2698131.note: Rabbi Menachem and Faygie Andrusier. Its own About page, first published July 23 2015 (https://www.manchesterjewishlife.com/templates/articlecco_cdo/aid/3015631/jewish/About-Us.htm): they 'are living in Manchester, VT with their 8 children and are excited to make Manchester their home ... Please check our website for more information and launch dates', so it was starting by 2015; therebbesimpact.com gives 2014 and the chabad.org listing number (2698131) points to about 2014 (leads).

559424.name: Chabad of Kanata
559424.note: Ottawa Jewish Bulletin (about 2021, 'Russian-speaking Jews more engaged with community thanks to Genesis grant'): 'Gershzon said in 2005, the "Acheinu Board" was established to address the growing needs of a Russian-speaking Jewish population, which eventually led to the development of the Chabad of Kanata by bringing Rabbi Gershzon to Ottawa', so after 2005 (https://www.ottawajewishbulletin.com/jewish-ottawa/russian-speaking-jews-more-engaged-with-community-thanks-to-genesis-grant). The Chesed Fund (undated): the Gershzons 'founded Chabad of Kanata almost two decades ago'. therebbesimpact.com and the listing number point to 2007 (leads).
